title: Unblock AuthGate after login and add explicit initialization error states

requirements.summary: Ensure authenticated users proceed past the splash/login flow to the main Calendar + Chat screen without getting stuck on the AuthGate full-screen loader.
acceptanceCriteria: After a successful Internet Identity login and proceeding past the splash page, the user sees the main screen containing the calendar and the group chat (as currently shown on the Calendar page) without an infinite loading spinner.
The app no longer blocks indefinitely on the full-screen loader in AuthGate.
Manual refresh is not required to reach the main calendar + chat screen.

file_operations.description: Adjust AuthGate gating so the router (and thus the CalendarMonthPage with embedded ChatPanel) reliably renders after login. Replace the current unconditional full-screen loading block (based on actorFetching/profileLoading) with a bounded/defensive flow that (a) does not keep the entire app behind an infinite spinner and (b) only blocks when strictly necessary (e.g., initial identity boot), while allowing the main calendar+chat route to render once authenticated even if optional queries are still resolving. Align the profile-setup gating with the authorization component guidance (actor dependency + isFetched) to avoid blocking rendering. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a user-visible AuthGate error state with recovery actions when actor/profile initialization fails or stalls, instead of silently showing the loading spinner indefinitely.
acceptanceCriteria: If actor/profile initialization cannot complete, the user sees an English error message on screen (not only in console).
The error state provides a working recovery action (at minimum: a Retry button that re-attempts initialization, or a Reload button).
In normal conditions, the error state does not appear and the main calendar + chat screen loads as expected.

file_operations.description: Create a small, reusable AuthGate error UI that displays an English message explaining that initialization failed or is taking too long, plus recovery actions (Retry to re-attempt initialization; Reload to refresh the app). Build the UI using existing shadcn-ui primitives already in use (e.g., Card/Button) for consistency. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire explicit error handling into AuthGate: detect initialization failures (e.g., actor/profile query errors) and stalls (e.g., timeout while authenticated but actor/profile cannot become ready) and show AuthGateErrorState instead of an infinite spinner. Implement Retry by triggering re-initialization via React Query invalidation/refetch of the actor/profile queries (using their existing query keys) and ensure the normal path still renders the main Calendar + Chat screen. Incorporate the authorization component’s frontend error-handling guidance so backend authorization traps and initialization errors surface as user-readable messages. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
